fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: She started having me lay back and get comfortable, as she gently explored and stroked around my down… She said the feathers were so soft down there…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: It was a really special night… And I owe her a lot to help me come out of my shell…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I’ll never forget how her little curious paws felt… Seeing her cute lil’ excited face as she explored…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: As I began to relax, she started to work her way inside, and GOSH~! She really knows how to please a lady, bahaw!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Hey, I see my message found you…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: So what’s the plan this time?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I’d like to return the favor.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: How about you fool around in me and we’ll see where it goes from there?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Great! Climb on top lil’ guy, show me what you got!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Been a while since I’ve been on the receiving end…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Aw, but now you’re slipping out!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Yeah but it feels so gooooood.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: But uh… Do squeeze when I’m gonna cum…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Well in that case… Time to squeeze!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Y’know, you look pretty cute next to my meat.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: How about you give it some attention?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Big ole hunkin’ thing like this? Of course I’ll be giving it some attention!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Heh, hard to imagine this thing was inside ya, eh?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: No worries, now it’s time for my revenge!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: You won’t be able to walk straight for a week!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Ok big guy, how about you put that mouth to work?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Lap up that pre while you’re at it…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Big ole guy like you sensitive to a lil tongue like mine?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Hah, yeah I’ve got a soft spot for little cuties.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Alright, I’m about to lose it.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Think you can wrap your mouth around me?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Gah, that’s it. Gulp it down…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Mmm yeah that was good… Aside from the mess you made…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Yeah but it’s partly your mess, so I figured we could clean it together…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: You’ve got a silver tongue on ya. In more ways than one!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Get up here and let me taste it…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The two finish up and cuddle for a bit before separating ways.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Rascal ducks down under the counter…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Maaaaavieeee~! We’ve got some <wiggle a=0.075 f=2.5>shmekels</wiggle> for ya!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Just a couple things! Some claw clippers, floss, a spatula, cooking oil-

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: No, something’s up… I can <speed=0.25>smell it… <waitfor=0.5><speed=1>Is Rascal here?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Right before you guys came in! I keep telling him he’s gotta take a shower! <color=#838383>He’s a really stinky pan-!</color>

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *Next scene where rascal is sucking him off*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: <speed=0.25>And this… <wave a=0.1 f=3>“shlucking”</wave> sound I’m hearing…?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: <speed=0.1>Uh… <speed=1>O-old pipes y’know… <waitfor=0.5>Sprung a leak in the back… <waitfor=0.5>it’s a… <waitfor=0.5><size=10><color=#838383>mmmnggg…</color> <size=16>It’s a mess…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *Next illustration, rascal face full of dong*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: And this new smell… Like… hmm… <waitfor=0.5>Help me out here Claire…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: <speed=0.25>Well . . . <waitfor=0.5><speed=0.75>I guess in that case I’ll carry on with my order.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Let’s remove the last things on the list.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Now I’m just looking for something <size=18><speed=0.25>thick and hard . . .

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Ok that’s it, I’m going back there.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: N-no! This area is employees only!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I see we just missed the show…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Oh he can go again. Maverick’s a marathon man.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: No, no, everyone out of the counter. I have to clean this up before anyone else—

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: My back’s been acting up again… I was wondering if ya had any of those herbs?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: … I’m gonna keep messing with him…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Oh don’t worry, Bucky’s kinda hard of hearing. If we keep our voice down—

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Maverick, thats my bad ear, speak at this one!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The herbs, yes they are just over—

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *animate up the hand with the herbs, like, slide it upward over a second or two.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: <color=#838383>You think you can just get a free show?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Wow did you just… <waitfor=0.75>cum from making a sale?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: That’s such a big step for you! I told ya it makes the work day better!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Ok, so what do I owe ya for all this?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Well great! I’m going to leave before you change your mind!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Also heh… <waitfor=0.5>I like your new tails!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Maverick looks under the counter to see a mess of critters and spunk. The coyotes are hungrily lapping away at Rascal.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: OK LADIES. If you want to be employees so badly, you must pass the interview!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: But I didn’t bring my resume!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Rascal, you’re being promoted to Manager’s Assistant.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I need your help with the routine cookie inspection!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Maybe attached to a pair of big <waitfor=0.5><size=18>fluffy <waitfor=0.5><size=24>NUTS-

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: No, I need a new ice pack… my previous one sprung a leak and…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Oh no, Claire… <shake a=0.3>we haven’t shaved…</shake>

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Throughout the night, mice swap partners, positions, and fluids.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The mice lose themselves in a tangle of paws and tails.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: And of course, they shower their warrior with just as much love and affection.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: As Rascal places the jar near the stump, two elder female mice approach him, their bodies adorned from head to paw with intricate tattoos. They gesture for Rascal to lie down.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: One mouse working on Rascal’s thighs trail off, settling between his legs. They explore his sheath and move down to his balls. The mouse strokes them lovingly for just a moment, before one of the elders scolds them.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: When he lowers his head, the mice gently place leaves over his eyes. With his vision obscured, Rascal focuses on the sounds around him. The pitter-patter of tiny paws fills the air, growing louder as more mice join in.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: As the leaves are lifted from Rascal's eyes, he looks down and sees intricate swirls and shapes perfectly mirrored across his body. Nearby, a few mice beam with pride at their handiwork.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: A floral aroma pierces Rascal's nostrils as the mice begin grinding something. One of the elders barks out commands, and the air fills with citrus and a trace of mint.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: “Thank you!” Rascal says, while one of the mice leads him toward the campfire. More mice gather around, watching intently as the elders take turns tossing various items into the fire.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Small paws move methodically over Rascal's body, tracing bold strokes and intricate swirls. The mice work in perfect harmony.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Across the clearing, the stump housing Mabel glows with a steady rhythm, each pulse casting vibrant light. With every burst of color, the campfire’s flames respond in unison.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The elder mice's chants become louder! Pink flames and streaks explode out from the campfire! As this happens, the group of mice pair off and begin kissing.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The flames die down as the ritual comes to an end. Exhausted and dripping mice motion for Rascal to follow them to a nearby creek.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Two mice climb on Rascal and begin exploring his snout. “I’ll just follow their lead” thinks Rascal, as they smooch around his lips. He lightly caresses the mice and brings them in closer.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: They wash up and return to the campfire...

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The three take turns making out and exploring each other. Rascal gets bolder with his tongue, and the mice reflect his energy. And then, the trees alight with a brilliant red. And the ritual begins...
